支持最多‌3 段音频‌（需与图像或视频搭配，总时长不超 15 秒），用于设置节奏、对白或环境声。
支持最多‌3 段视频‌（每段 2-15 秒，总时长不超过 15 秒），用于定义运镜风格或动作逻辑。

混合限制‌：
所有素材（图 + 视频 + 音频）混合输入时，总数不得超过‌12 个‌！！

参考图像最多只能接入9张图像，如果不接入就用开关关掉

widgets_values: @Image 1 The shot quickly pushes into the detail of the coffee surface's milk foam, cocoa powder particles, and dark coffee liquid texture, letting the surface particles, foam, and liquid ripples gradually cover the entire screen, obscuring everything else. The shot maintains a realistic macro texture, extremely shallow depth of field, with fine powder slowly falling in backlight, the surface texture like a transition between fine sand and fluid. Avoid screen cracking. At the moment the coffee powder particles, milk foam undulations, liquid swirls are highly similar to the sand dune ridges, wind erosion textures, and blowing sand particles in @Image 2, naturally and seamlessly transform into a desert landscape. Then the shot continues to push forward, revealing the full view of the sand dunes from @Image 2. Strictly avoid screen cracking, no black screen, no hard cuts, no obvious special effects, no sense of splicing. Overall, it should be real, quiet, restrained, like the same granular material naturally changing from the coffee's microscopic surface into a macroscopic desert world. One continuous shot, no splicing in the middle.

基础调度器上的步数为总步数，分离sigmas上的为一采步数（不能低于6）总步数减去一采的步数就等于二采的步数（不要低于4），例如：总步数为12步，Sigmas填了8步，那8步就为一采步数，剩下4步就是二采的步数。总为10，Sigmas为6，那么一采为6步，二采为4步。傻逼都能懂！

PS: 一采最少6步，想要音质好一点就8步。
